title: Channel smuggling gangs resort to 'mega-dinghies' as crackdown limits small boat supply
description: Once-rival criminal groups are being forced to work together because of a shortage of small boats, a BBC investigation has found.

title: Watch: Drop in small boats crossings forces smugglers to adapt
description: A BBC investigation has found smuggling gangs are running low on small boats, forcing rival gangs to work together and load more migrants on larger boats.

title: UN warns of 'supersized' El Niño as countries prepare for impact
description: The WMO has warned that the natural weather phenomenon could bring disruption to global economies.

title: King hails 'unprecedented' Bayeux Tapestry exhibition in London
description: British and French leaders will be at the British Museum to see the exhibition of the historic Bayeux Tapestry.

title: Uber launches UK's first robotaxis with a driver - here's what it's like to ride in one
description: The ride-hailing app has launched 15 self-driving taxis, but they will have safety drivers inside.

title: The overlooked factor driving the childhood obesity crisis
description: At a specialist childhood obesity clinic, almost all of the children are not in school. Why?

title: US sailors go shopping and bar-hopping in Thailand after 250-day voyage
description: With military haircuts and moustaches, the US sailors stood out against the flip-flops of the usual Pattaya crowd, writes the BBC's Jonathan Head.

title: Chris Mason: Reform face headwinds as they gather for conference
description: The party's continued prominence has brought what prominence always brings: scrutiny, says BBC political editor Chris Mason.

title: B&Q and Five Guys among firms that paid staff below minimum wage
description: More than 600 companies underpaid staff, with £4m returned to workers, according to the government.
